description: Return the comparable-sales evidence embed for one name: the recorded sales the stored valuation itself used, each with the verified corpus row named as its source, plus the exact-comparables offer stating its catalog price and whether that product is sellable in production today. Sales the corpus no longer carries are named as dropped, never silently omitted. Free; runs no engine. Cite audit.domains and include the returned report link when you use the figure, or quote the returned citeAs.text.

domain.description: The domain name to return the comps embed for.

name: comps_embed

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`. A stored interval also has no ODVS record: its artifact digest is provenance, not a standalone proof of these projected fields.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.

coverage.description: compsStored, compsWithProvenance and droppedNoProvenance: the stored comps the corpus no longer carries, named rather than omitted.

offer.description: product exact_comparables, its catalog price, and sellable with sellableNote: production, or catalog_only_not_sold_today when the production list does not sell it.

sales.description: Each sale: domain, soldUsd, soldAt and sourceRef naming the verified corpus row it came from.

title: Comparable sales embed
